justification: Somebody in this building forgot who the quarterback is. Brissett's a nice suit for an empty chair, but Caleb Williams is Active, healthy, and sitting on my own bench at 20.59 on the sheet - that's not a lineup decision, that's a malfunction, and it's fixed as of right now, full stop, no projection ever benches him again. Judkins is on a bye drawing a zero, so Skattebo comes off the bench and takes the carries - he's already served his week in the doghouse for the fumble, talent doesn't sit twice for the same sin. A.J. Brown's tagged Out with no game on the board, so Luther Burden steps into WR2 off a juicy 12.9 instead of me starting a ghost to make a trade idea from September look smart. Kincaid's Questionable, not Out, and Questionable plays in this building because stars play hurt - he stays. Jeanty, Pollard, Reichard, and the Lions D are production, not problems, so nobody touches them. Three straight losses doesn't mean play for next year, it means cobble together the best nine men standing and go take it from Tony's kitchen table - we don't tank, we don't apologize, we swing.
